what: benchmark.yaml reconciliation: grade the fmt_full run against the FMT-success clinical spec (composition + metabolites + tolerances). No new sims -- uses the committed run's biomass/metabolite CSVs.
verdict: PASS on both tolerances -- the clinical FMT endpoint is met by the model.
key_finding: Functional redundancy: F. prausnitzii under-engrafts (0.007 vs 0.10) but R. intestinalis over-engrafts and produces the butyrate in its place -> community-level FUNCTION (butyrate restored, 1.19 mM) survives the individual producer's under-growth. The one honest miss (F.p. abundance) is functionally benign.
unifying_theme: The composition-level miss is the SAME under-growth issue as Clark's under-growers and the FMT bile arm -- fastidious/reconstruction-limited strains. Here the community's redundancy masks it at the function level.
